mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 3.0%, it indicates aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic activity and boosts equity market sentiment, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, rising residential construction permits and consumer spending signal robust economic growth that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions defined by HOUST and RSAFS, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits fall below 1500.0, it signals a contraction in the housing market that reduces economic activity and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1500.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits and consumer spending indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that depresses corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recovery expansions, a rising industrial production index signals improving manufacturing output that supports corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during post-recovery expansions defined by INDPRO growth, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
